releases.body:
## 简体中文

### 变更

- **同步官方 2026-11 Go 额度表**：DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 月度额度 **$80 → $100**（Go Plus **$160 → $200**）。这是本次唯一的金额变动。
- **新增 6 个模型**：
  - `gemini-4-argon` — $30 / $120
  - `kimi-k3.1-pro` — $15 / $60
  - `minimax-m3.1-flash` — $20 / $80
  - `hy4` — $60 / $240
  - `beam-free`、`iceman-contributor-free` — 免费（显示 `∞`）
- **修正模型 ID 与额度**：`step-5-preview-free` → `step-5-preview`。该模型已转为付费，额度 $15 / $60，此前误显示为免费。
- **移除 6 个官方已下架模型**：`grok-4.6`、`space-bunny`、`minimax-m2.7`、`deepseek-v4-flash`、`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`、`longcat-2.5-preview-free`。未收录模型仍显示 `—`。
- **可维护性**：额度表改为按模型 ID 升序排列，便于与官方表逐条对照；Go Teams（Go + $5/模型）不纳入参考行。

### 升级

```sh
opencode plugin update "opencode-usage-limits@latest"
```

配置条目不带 `@latest` 时，用 `opencode plugin update opencode-usage-limits`。

选中 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 时，面板底部参考额度应显示 `$100/$200`。

---

## English

### Changed

- **Synced with the official 2026-11 Go allowance table**: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is now **$100/month** (Go Plus **$200**), up from **$80/$160**. This is the only price change in this release.
- **Added 6 models**:
  - `gemini-4-argon` — $30 / $120
  - `kimi-k3.1-pro` — $15 / $60
  - `minimax-m3.1-flash` — $20 / $80
  - `hy4` — $60 / $240
  - `beam-free`, `iceman-contributor-free` — free (shown as `∞`)
- **Fixed model ID and allowance**: `step-5-preview-free` → `step-5-preview`. The model is paid now ($15 / $60) and was previously reported as free.
- **Removed 6 delisted models**: `grok-4.6`, `space-bunny`, `minimax-m2.7`, `deepseek-v4-flash`, `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`, `longcat-2.5-preview-free`. Unknown models keep rendering `—`.
- **Maintenance**: the table is sorted by model ID so it can be diffed against the docs page; Go Teams (Go + $5 per model) is not shown in the reference line.

### Upgrade

```sh
opencode plugin update "opencode-usage-limits@latest"
```

Use `opencode plugin update opencode-usage-limits` when the configured entry has no `@latest` suffix.

With DeepSeek V4.1 Flash selected, the reference line should read `$100/$200`.

---

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/GamingNowEdward/opencode-usage-limits/compare/v0.3.2...v0.3.3

## 修复 / Fixed

- **npm 安装后插件完全无法加载**（[#2](https://github.com/GamingNowEdward/opencode-usage-limits/issues/2)）：
  0.3.1 直接发布 `.tsx` 源码，而 OpenCode 只对 `node_modules` **之外**的插件文件运行自带的 Solid
  Babel 转换。npm 安装的插件目录里源码由 Bun 自行转译，会按 `@jsxImportSource` 注入
  `@opentui/solid/jsx-dev-runtime`；该注入发生在宿主重写 import 之后，于是回到 Bun 原生解析，
  而 `@opentui/solid` 是可选 peer、npm 不会安装，最终 `stage=load` 失败，侧边栏不出现、插件列表也没有条目。
  现在发布**编译产物** `dist/tui.js`，`exports["./tui"]` 指向它。
- **The plugin failed to load entirely on npm installs**: 0.3.1 shipped raw `.tsx`, but OpenCode only
  runs its Solid Babel transform on plugin files outside `node_modules`, so Bun transpiled the installed
  source and injected an unresolvable `@opentui/solid/jsx-dev-runtime` import (`stage=load` failure).
  The package now ships the compiled `dist/tui.js`, built with
  `babel-preset-solid { generate: "universal", moduleName: "@opentui/solid" }` and bundled by esbuild,
  keeping `@opentui/solid` / `solid-js` / `@opencode/plugin/tui` external so the host rewrites them.

## 变更 / Changed

- 新增 `scripts/build.mjs`（`npm run build`，`npm run dev` 监听），发布前由 `prepack` 自动构建；
  构建产物自带自检，若重新出现 JSX runtime 调用会直接失败。
- 发布包仅包含 `index.ts`、`dist/tui.js` 与文档；`.tsx` 源码只保留在仓库内。
- Added `scripts/build.mjs` (`npm run build`, `npm run dev`), run automatically through `prepack`, with
  a post-build assertion that fails if the artifact ever regains a JSX runtime call.
- The published package now contains only `index.ts`, `dist/tui.js` and docs; the `.tsx` sources stay in
  the repository.

## 致谢 / Thanks

- 感谢 [@third774](https://github.com/third774) 报告该问题、定位到 JSX 运行时注入路径，并先行验证了
  「发布编译产物」这一方案；0.3.2 采用的正是该方案。
- Thanks to [@third774](https://github.com/third774) for reporting the issue, pinpointing the injected
  JSX runtime path, and verifying the compiled-output approach — 0.3.2 adopts that option.

## 升级 / Upgrade

```sh
opencode plugin remove opencode-usage-limits
opencode plugin add opencode-usage-limits
```

若 `opencode plugin list` 仍显示 0.3.1，先清掉 npm 元数据缓存再重装：
`npm cache clean --force`（或等待缓存自然过期）。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/GamingNowEdward/opencode-usage-limits/compare/v0.3.1...v0.3.2

The OpenCode v2.1 credential migration broke the sidebar: login credentials moved from `auth.json` into the `credential` table of `opencode.db`, so `resolveKey()` found no key for `opencode-go` and the panel stayed stuck on `API key not found`.

**Fixed**
- Keys are now read through `context.client.credential.list()` first (the active entry wins), with `<PROVIDER>_API_KEY` and `auth.json` kept as fallbacks.
- OpenCode Go prefers the host's `/api/experimental/usage/limits` meters when the installed client exposes them (no key needed); on 2.1.4 that endpoint is absent, so it falls back to the Zen usage endpoint.
- `preview.mjs` can read the v2 credential store, so the panel can be verified without starting the TUI.

---

OpenCode v2.1 把登录凭据从 `auth.json` 迁移到了 `opencode.db` 的 `credential` 表，插件仍只读旧路径，导致选中 OpenCode Go 时固定显示 `API key not found`。

**修复**
- 现在优先通过 `context.client.credential.list()` 读取密钥（active 条目优先），`<PROVIDER>_API_KEY` 和 `auth.json` 作为兜底。
- 新版宿主提供 `/api/experimental/usage/limits` 时，OpenCode Go 直接使用该接口（无需密钥）；2.1.4 没有该端点，自动回退到 Zen 用量接口。
- `preview.mjs` 支持读取 v2 凭据库，无需启动 TUI 即可验证。

See [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md) · [SLSA provenance](https://registry.npmjs.org/-/npm/v1/attestations/opencode-usage-limits@0.3.1)

﻿OpenCode Go allowances became **per model** ($15–$80, plus a Go Plus tier), so the flat
$12 /  /  budgets no longer hold. Measurement also shows the reported percentage **cannot be
converted into dollars** — 84% monthly corresponded to $49.27 of real 30-day spend, implying a
~$59 allowance rather than $80.

**Changed**
- OpenCode Go windows now show **percentages only**; the used / limit row is gone.
- A new reference line at the bottom shows the selected model and its allowance
  (`deepseek-v4.1-flash   $80/$160`) from the official 31-model table. Unknown models render as -,
  free models as ∞. Reference only — it takes no part in any calculation.
- The `limits` option is narrowed to a ClinePass fallback.
- **ClinePass is unchanged**: caps are still read live from `/users/me/plan`.

**Fixed**
- `formatUsd` no longer throws when a window has no limit.

---

OpenCode Go 额度改为**按模型区分**（$15–$80，另有 Go Plus 档），原有的统一 $12 /  / 
不再成立。实测进一步表明百分比**无法**换算成美元：月度 84% 对应 30 天实际花费 $49.27，
反推额度约 $59 而非 $80。

**变更**
- OpenCode Go 窗口改为**只显示百分比**，已用 / 限额 行已移除。
- 面板底部新增**模型额度参考行**（`deepseek-v4.1-flash   $80/$160`），数据来自官方 31 模型表。
  未收录模型显示 -，免费模型显示 ∞。仅作参考，不参与计算。
- `limits` 配置项收窄为 ClinePass 回退。
- **ClinePass 行为不变**：额度仍从 `/users/me/plan` 实时读取。

**修复**
- 额度缺失时 `formatUsd` 不再抛异常。

见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md) · [SLSA provenance](https://registry.npmjs.org/-/npm/v1/attestations/opencode-usage-limits@0.3.0)

First automated release through GitHub Actions with npm trusted publishing (OIDC) - no npm token is stored in this repository.

**Docs**
- npm version / downloads / license badges and a Requirements section in both READMEs.

**Verification**
- Published from this repository's publish.yml workflow, with an automatically generated [SLSA provenance attestation](https://registry.npmjs.org/-/npm/v1/attestations/opencode-usage-limits@0.2.1).
- `npm i opencode-usage-limits@0.2.1`

---

首个通过 GitHub Actions + npm 可信发布（OIDC）自动发布的版本，仓库中不存储任何 npm token。

**文档**
- 两份 README 增加 npm 徽章与「要求」小节。

**验证**
- 由本仓库的 `publish.yml` 工作流发布，并自动生成 [SLSA provenance 来源证明](https://registry.npmjs.org/-/npm/v1/attestations/opencode-usage-limits@0.2.1)。
